lessons.title: Dụng cụ và dịch vụ làm móng
lessons.objective: Gọi tên dụng cụ và các dịch vụ cơ bản trong tiệm nail.
lessons.reading: Welcome to our nail salon. We do manicures and pedicures. I use a nail file to shape the nails and a buffer to make them smooth. I push back the cuticles with a cuticle pusher. Then I paint the nails with a base coat, two coats of colour and a top coat. We also do gel nails and acrylic nails.

dialogue.text: Welcome to our nail salon.
dialogue.translation: Chào mừng bạn đến với tiệm nail của chúng tôi.

dialogue.text: We do manicures and pedicures.
dialogue.translation: Chúng tôi làm móng tay và móng chân.

dialogue.text: I use a nail file to shape the nails and a buffer to make them smooth.
dialogue.translation: Tôi dùng dũa móng để tạo dáng móng và dụng cụ chà bóng để làm móng mịn.

dialogue.text: I push back the cuticles with a cuticle pusher.
dialogue.translation: Tôi đẩy da quanh móng bằng cây đẩy da.

dialogue.text: Then I paint the nails with a base coat, two coats of colour and a top coat.
dialogue.translation: Sau đó tôi sơn móng bằng một lớp sơn lót, hai lớp sơn màu và một lớp sơn bóng.

dialogue.text: We also do gel nails and acrylic nails.
dialogue.translation: Chúng tôi cũng làm móng gel và móng bột.

lessons.title: Vệ sinh và an toàn trong tiệm
lessons.objective: Nói về vệ sinh dụng cụ và an toàn cho khách.
lessons.reading: We clean and disinfect all metal tools after every customer. We use new files and buffers for each person. The pedicure tubs are cleaned with disinfectant and we use liners. We wear gloves and masks. If a customer has a cut or an infection, we do not do the service and we ask them to see a doctor. Good ventilation is important because of the chemicals.

lessons.title: Hướng dẫn khách chăm sóc móng tại nhà

lessons.reading:
Technician: Before you go, let me give you a few tips so your gel lasts as long as possible.

lessons.title: Hiểu thành phần sản phẩm và dị ứng
lessons.objective: Giải thích nguyên nhân dị ứng gel, vai trò của việc sấy đúng cách và thử dị ứng.
lessons.reading:
Customer: After my last gel manicure, the skin around my nails turned red and itchy. Should I be worried?
Technician: It could be an allergic reaction, most likely to methacrylates such as HEMA, which are found in many gel products. Once someone becomes sensitised, the reaction tends to get worse with each exposure.
Customer: So I can never have gel again?
Technician: Not necessarily. There are hypoallergenic, HEMA-free systems, although they aren't entirely risk-free. The key is proper curing — under-cured gel is far more likely to trigger a reaction — and keeping the product off the skin during application.
Customer: Is it safe to try today?
Technician: I'd recommend a patch test on one nail first, and we'll wait forty-eight hours before doing the rest. It's slower, but it's the responsible way to go about it.

lessons.title: Xử lý sự cố phản ứng và lập báo cáo
lessons.objective: Giữ bình tĩnh khi khách có phản ứng, hỏi triệu chứng nghiêm trọng và lập báo cáo sự cố.
lessons.reading:
Customer: My fingers are burning and swelling. I think something's wrong.
Technician: Please stay calm. I'm going to remove the product straight away and rinse your hands with cool water. Are you having any difficulty breathing, or any swelling of the lips?
Customer: No, just my fingers.
Technician: Good. Even so, I'd advise you to see a doctor if it doesn't settle within an hour. I'll write up an incident report with the product names and batch numbers, so your doctor has all the details.
Customer: Will I be charged?
Technician: Certainly not. Our priority is your wellbeing. Here's my manager's number, and we'll follow up with you tomorrow.

lessons.title: Giải thích khoa học về cấu trúc móng
lessons.objective: Giải thích bằng ngôn ngữ dễ hiểu vì sao móng tách lớp và cách bảo vệ móng.
lessons.reading:
Customer: Why do my nails keep peeling in layers? It's so frustrating.
Technician: What you're describing is called lamellar splitting. Nails are made of keratin, a protein arranged in tightly packed layers. When the layers separate, they peel.
Customer: What causes that?
Technician: Usually repeated wetting and drying, harsh products, or trauma such as using your nails as tools. Nutrition can play a part too, although the evidence for supplements is mixed.
Customer: So no miracle cure?
Technician: Unfortunately not. The most reliable remedy is protection: moisturise, wear gloves, and keep the nails short while they recover. Growth is slow — a fingernail takes roughly six months to grow out completely — so patience is essential.

lessons.objective: Viết và đọc một bài phát biểu ngắn: kể chuyện, nêu giá trị và kêu gọi hành động.
lessons.reading:
Owner: Good evening, everyone, and thank you for joining us tonight. When I opened my first salon eight years ago, I had two chairs, a borrowed table and more doubt than certainty. Tonight, we're opening our fifth location, and that wouldn't have been possible without every person in this room.
Owner: Success in this industry isn't measured only in revenue. It's measured in the trust a client places in your hands, week after week. That trust is earned through craftsmanship, honesty and genuine care.
Owner: So let me say this plainly: what we build next will be defined not by how fast we grow, but by how well we look after one another and the people we serve. Please raise a glass to our team, to our clients, and to the future.

dialogue.text: Owner: Good evening, everyone, and thank you for joining us tonight.
dialogue.translation: Chủ tiệm: Chào buổi tối mọi người, và cảm ơn mọi người đã đến cùng chúng tôi tối nay.

dialogue.text: When I opened my first salon eight years ago, I had two chairs, a borrowed table and more doubt than certainty.
dialogue.translation: Khi tôi mở tiệm đầu tiên cách đây tám năm, tôi chỉ có hai chiếc ghế, một cái bàn mượn và nhiều nghi ngờ hơn là chắc chắn.

dialogue.text: Tonight, we're opening our fifth location, and that wouldn't have been possible without every person in this room.
dialogue.translation: Tối nay, chúng ta khai trương địa điểm thứ năm, và điều đó đã không thể có được nếu thiếu từng người trong căn phòng này.

dialogue.text: Owner: Success in this industry isn't measured only in revenue.
dialogue.translation: Chủ tiệm: Thành công trong ngành này không chỉ được đo bằng doanh thu.

dialogue.text: It's measured in the trust a client places in your hands, week after week.
dialogue.translation: Nó được đo bằng niềm tin mà một khách hàng đặt vào đôi tay của bạn, hết tuần này đến tuần khác.

dialogue.text: That trust is earned through craftsmanship, honesty and genuine care.
dialogue.translation: Niềm tin đó có được nhờ tay nghề, sự trung thực và sự quan tâm chân thành.

dialogue.text: Owner: So let me say this plainly: what we build next will be defined not by how fast we grow, but by how well we look after one another and the people we serve.
dialogue.translation: Chủ tiệm: Vì vậy, hãy để tôi nói thẳng: điều chúng ta xây dựng tiếp theo sẽ được định hình không phải bởi việc chúng ta lớn nhanh đến đâu, mà bởi việc chúng ta chăm sóc nhau và những người chúng ta phục vụ tốt đến mức nào.

dialogue.text: Please raise a glass to our team, to our clients, and to the future.
dialogue.translation: Xin mọi người nâng ly vì đội ngũ của chúng ta, vì khách hàng của chúng ta, và vì tương lai.

vocabulary.example: I had more doubt than certainty.

grammar.title: Tu từ trong diễn thuyết: not by X, but by Y / wouldn't have been possible without... / ba ý song song
grammar.explanation: Dùng cấu trúc đối lập và ba ý song song để bài nói có nhịp điệu và dễ nhớ.
examples: We will be defined not by how fast we grow, but by how well we care.
That wouldn't have been possible without you.
It's measured in trust, week after week.

pronunciation.focus: Ngắt nhịp ba ý: honesty, [pause] craftsmanship, [pause] and genuine care.
pronunciation.tip: Ngắt nghỉ ngắn giữa ba ý song song và hạ giọng ở ý cuối.

speakingTasks: Viết và đọc phần mở đầu một bài phát biểu khai trương trong 4 câu.
Dùng cấu trúc 'not by..., but by...' để nêu giá trị của tiệm.

questions.prompt: How many chairs did the first salon have?
questions.explanation: 'I had two chairs'.

questions.prompt: How many locations does the owner open tonight?
questions.explanation: 'we're opening our fifth location'.

questions.prompt: How is success measured, according to the owner?
options: In the trust clients place in your hands
questions.explanation: 'measured in the trust a client places in your hands'.

questions.prompt: How is trust earned?
questions.explanation: 'earned through craftsmanship, honesty and genuine care'.

questions.prompt: What will define the business's future?
options: How well they look after one another and their clients
questions.explanation: 'defined not by how fast we grow, but by how well we look after one another'.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I had more doubt than _____.
questions.explanation: “certainty” nghĩa là “sự chắc chắn”. Câu đầy đủ: I had more doubt than certainty.

questions.prompt: What does “craftsmanship” mean?
questions.explanation: “craftsmanship” = tay nghề thủ công. Ví dụ: Our reputation rests on craftsmanship.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: We offer _____ care to every client.
questions.explanation: “genuine” nghĩa là “chân thành, thật sự”. Câu đầy đủ: We offer genuine care to every client.

questions.prompt: What does “earn” mean?
questions.explanation: “earn” = giành được (niềm tin). Ví dụ: Trust has to be earned.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Our values _____ who we are.
questions.explanation: “define” nghĩa là “định hình”. Câu đầy đủ: Our values define who we are.
